negative_reviews.author: Peter Bersch
negative_reviews.text:
My ramen was very disappointing. I got the most expensive ramen and it had 5 pieces of meat, noodles, one egg, and a bit of one vegetable. The ramen was way too spicy and my side dish/Edamame didn’t have enough salt. For someone who eats ramen passionately it was really not the right choice to eat there.
I hope it was a one time messed up dish since we ate at 7:30pm and the restaurant closes at 8:00pm. The story of the founder sounded great!
Gluten-free is not an option.

issues: Order accuracy failing — items missing and dishes prepared incorrectly before leaving the shop.
Communication breakdown with the distributor: wrong stock delivered, calls not returned and no solutions offered, forcing order cancellations during busy periods.
Sales short of target with covers down year on year, partly attributed to trade lost to the new West End location.
Customer reviews citing small portion sizes and pricing; the gluten-free option exists but customers rarely ask and extra seasoning could have been offered.
Premises licence still needs transferring; personal licence now obtained but the change will take weeks.

Report operational issues to the office regularly so supplier failures are fed back and fixed — Owner: Ka Ho (28/07/2026)
Initiate the premises licence transfer once the required documentation is received — Owner: Justina (28/07/2026)
